facts.text: Real ghat lines are steep: the historic Bhor Ghat incline was built at about 1 in 40, with a stretch of 1 in 37. This route's climb is gentler.
Indian farming has two main seasons: kharif crops such as paddy grow June–October, and rabi crops such as wheat and mustard are sown in November and harvested in April–May.
Hill railways need many tunnels: the Konkan Railway lists 91 tunnels on its 738.9 km line.
Pulling the alarm chain without good reason is an offence under Section 141 of the Railways Act, 1989.
